title: We decided to stop optimizing for engagement.
body:
Most news apps are built to keep you scrolling as long as possible. They prioritize the most controversial headlines because those get the most clicks. We chose a different path at Headlinne.

Instead of chasing rage or clicks, our feed is designed to minimize the time you spend finding what actually matters to you. We built our AI to look for relevance rather than reaction. It focuses on the topics you follow and the depth you prefer, not on what will make you angry enough to stay online.

This makes for a shorter, quieter experience. We know that sounds counterintuitive for a tech company. But we believe the value of a news app is measured by how well it informs you, not by how many minutes it steals from your day.
cta: See how a different kind of feed works at HEADLINNE.com.
